verdict.rationale: Bench's own docs say bank and card accounts connect via Plaid. They also say data is pulled automatically from payment tools (Stripe, Square, Shopify) and payroll (Gusto), with transactions appearing within moments and merchant fees reconciled automatically. That covers banking, payments, and payroll flowing into the books. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and detail on how payroll (Gusto) data posts into the ledger beyond a single mention.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect my banking, payments, and payroll systems so their activity flows into the ledger automatically

citations.quote: automatically pulls in data from banks, cards, and tools like Shopify, Stripe, Square, and Gusto, with no manual entry
Link your bank and credit accounts in seconds to  automate the flow of information into Bench
